content:
Earlier this year, Twelve South launched the new Valet accessory, which the company describes as a "wireless charging station and personal everyday carry tray."

Now, Twelve South has expanded the Valet lineup with a smaller option featuring MagSafe and Qi2.2 wireless charging at speeds up to 25W.

The first generation Valet announced earlier this year measured 7.5 inches, offering enough room to hold a phone, keys, wallet, glasses and more. However, the new Valet has been significantly downsized to 4.25 inches.

Here's Twelve South's description of Valet's ultimate premium design:

Designed first as a beautiful home accent piece, then a precision wireless charger, Valet combines warm materials with modern precision to create a calmer, more intentional form that fits anywhere in the home—from the entryway console to the kitchen to the nightstand. Soft, square charging pad echoes the architectural lines of the leather tray. Meanwhile, a weighted zinc alloy base keeps everything grounded and tidy.

In terms of functionality, the smaller Valet has plenty of power to charge your iPhone. It also features a built-in additional USB-C port for conveniently charging other accessories:

  • Qi2.2 wireless charging up to 25W
  • Premium Nappa leather catchall tray
  • Four configurable placement orientations
  • Interchangeable, removable leather bezel
  • Weighted zinc alloy base with hidden cable management
  • Additional USB-C port supporting up to 10W wired charging
  • Includes 45W power supply and 1.5-meter USB-C cable

The 4.25-inch Twelve South Valet is available for ordering today at $129.99, offered in three different color combinations. Though the price is on the higher side, it's a beautiful spot to set your phone to charge while also holding your glasses, wallet, or keys.
